title: run_shell_command calls fail with "execvp(3) failed.: Permission denied"

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report provides a clear problem statement, specific environment details (RHEL8/9, Node 22/25, CLI v0.39.1, Linux, no sandbox), and actionable steps to reproduce ('echo Hello' or any external command fails with 'execvp(3) failed.: Permission denied').
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This issue involves platform-specific terminal execution behavior using node-pty and child_process on Linux/RHEL environments where pty spawn-helper binary permissions or pty execution failure prevents shell command execution, falling under PTY/spawn process management complexities.

summary.problem: Executing external commands via run_shell_command fails on RHEL Linux hosts with 'execvp(3) failed.: Permission denied'.
summary.root_cause: When @lydell/node-pty or node-pty spawns a shell in Unix environments, the native helper binary (spawn-helper) or shell execution fails due to missing executable permissions or execution restrictions. Additionally, when execvp fails inside node-pty, the error is written to the pty output stream without throwing a synchronous exception, bypassing the catch block that would fall back to child_process execution.
summary.context: This occurs on Linux environments (such as RHEL8 and RHEL9) across Node.js versions. Ensuring spawn-helper permissions are set correctly during getPty initialization and ensuring fallback to child_process when pty execution fails resolves the issue.

steps: Update getPty in packages/core/src/utils/getPty.ts to verify and set executable permissions (0o755) on the node-pty spawn-helper binary on Unix systems if present.
Update ShellExecutionService in packages/core/src/services/shellExecutionService.ts to detect pty execution failure (such as 'execvp(3) failed') and fall back to childProcessFallback.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When node-pty execution encounters permission issues or spawn-helper failure, shell command execution gracefully falls back to child_process and succeeds without failing.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/core/src/services/shellExecutionService.test.ts to simulate node-pty execvp failure and verify that execution falls back to child_process.
